static_traits.name: Li Jing
static_traits.educational_background: Currently studying at the University of Alabama
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends to confide in, but has not yet fully shared the extent of relationship insecurity
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history; has not experienced similar relationship problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear and organized expression, able to describe triggering situations and automatic thoughts specifically; good cooperation; neutral tone mixed with Anxiety; able to accept alternative interpretations and homework

basic_info.main_problem: Frequent thoughts in recent months that 'my girlfriend of 7 years may be tired of me, wanting change or to leave the relationship', especially obvious during arguments or when her behavior/daily routines change, causing significant Anxiety and insecurity, relationship tension, affected self-esteem, and interfering with learning and daily focus.
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts and doubts significantly affect my emotional health and our relationship; I hope to reduce Anxiety and insecurity through counseling, improve views on relationship stability, and maintain a more positive mindset.

core_beliefs: I will be abandoned by my partner

special_situations.event: After a small argument, my girlfriend seemed distant
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other appears distant after an argument, it means she is tired of me and considering ending the relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately communicates with the other, seeks comfort and reassurance; self-comforts; seeks advice from friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She wants to break up; she may leave me for someone else

special_situations.event: Noticing changes in my girlfriend's behavior or daily routines (different from usual)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If her behavior differs from before, it means she is tired of me and this relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously monitors the other's behavior changes, repeatedly rehearsing worst-case scenarios in the mind to 'warn' oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She has changed toward me; she may be considering leaving me

special_situations.event: My girlfriend proactively comforts and shows care; the relationship still has good moments together
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If she says she still cares, it may just be to not hurt me, not representing true feelings
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or weakening positive evidence to stay vigilant, continuing to search for negative clues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She is just saying it for me to hear, not true

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a dispute occurs, it means the relationship is heading toward its end
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly rehearsing breakup scenarios, seeking others' advice to reduce uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This argument may be the beginning of the breakup

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be steadily loved and attached to by the partner, obtaining clear commitment and security
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected, abandoned, the relationship suddenly breaking
defense_goal: Maintaining control and security through early warning and constant verification, avoiding sudden loss

object_relations.self_representation: An insecure partner who may be abandoned at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may distance or leave at any time (girlfriend)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the partner or counselor provides reassurance and positive evidence (emphasizing care and support in the relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to think the other is just being perfunctory to not hurt me, not sincere
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Raising questions in a hesitant tone, repeatedly emphasizing 'uncertain' and 'hard to believe', diluting positive information with probing and rhetorical questions, while returning to worrying scenarios.

manifestations: Persistent worry about relationship instability and repeated imagining of breakup scenarios
Quickly associates being abandoned during arguments or behavior changes
Difficulty accepting positive evidence, needing external reassurance to ease insecurity
outcomes: Attention and impaired academics, declining daily functioning

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing my girlfriend only comforts me to not hurt me, doubting her sincerity
When behavior changes, infers the other is considering leaving the relationship

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not yet fully sharing the extent of insecurity with friends, tending to keep Anxiety and doubts ruminating inside

positive_force: The 7-year relationship still has good interactions (she comforts, positive moments together)
Willing to proactively seek help and communicate (talking with partner about worries, seeking friends' advice)
Able to identify negative automatic thoughts and willing to try alternative interpretations and behavioral experiments
Has some support system (a few close friends to confide in)
negative_force: Prominent cognitive distortions like catastrophizing, mind-reading, predicting the future and negating the positive
Low tolerance for uncertainty, excessive focus on partner's behavior and daily changes
Strong Anxiety during relationship conflicts, damaged self-esteem and emotions
Repeated worry occupies cognitive resources, markedly affecting learning and concentration

target_behavior.behavior: Relationship-related excessive worry and catastrophic imagery (repeatedly rehearsing breakup scenarios)
antecedent: The partner seems distant or behaves differently from daily routines
target_behavior.core_reason: The insecure core belief about intimate relationships and cognitive distortions (catastrophizing, mind-reading, predicting the future, negating the positive) activated in uncertain situations
target_behavior.function: Escaping Anxiety from uncertainty, gaining temporary control and security by rehearsing worst scenarios and seeking reassurance
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension and declining mutual trust; emotional Anxiety and impaired self-esteem; markedly declining learning and daily focus
